decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.
Condition : 4 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the plans referenced for the ground floor wall opening, the area of demolition shall be restricted to 100mm in any direction from the structural opening.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved plans.

Condition : 7 - The wall coverings, plaster etc where the stud work is to be attached shall be carefully stripped to reveal any underlying timber frame that may exist, in addition to that which is already visible. If any further timber framework is found no part shall be cut or removed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority. A sample of the plasterboard metal stud work that would cover these timbers should be submitted for written approval by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to the house (adjoining the rear of the existing garage), replacement of vents and injection of damp treatment to ground floor flank wall, new stud wall to kitchen, bedroom, bathroom and 3/4m stud wall to bedroom (Listed Building consent)
